subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only route-binding summary RPC and Agents > Channels binding card, or keep binding inspection in the existing Config/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The request is useful and fits UI ergonomics, but it adds Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Accept generic routing visibility
options.body: Review and update the linked implementation or a replacement to expose a read-only binding summary with focused Gateway/UI tests.

options.title: Keep visibility in Config/CLI
options.body: Decide that raw config and CLI/status surfaces remain the supported inspection path and close this feature direction afterward.

options.title: Defer API shape
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product/API design item until maintainers settle the routing summary contract.

recommendation.title: Accept generic routing visibility
recommendation.body: Review and update the linked implementation or a replacement to expose a read-only binding summary with focused Gateway/UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily affects Control UI product shape and Gateway API exposure, and steipete has the strongest related triage/UI history in the evidence gathered.
